gate_p_pass_requires: actual candidate/tested full commit SHA and exact source+acceptance content identity
all three required commands with actual exit zero and raw stdout/stderr
all mapped Rust tests actually executed, none filtered/skipped/ignored
real Rust output for every frozen parity case with expected statuses and finite component comparison
local source review of the audit rows on the same tested code; read no-double-count paths and frame/measure conventions
known limitations, MissingAuthority domains and failures retained
insufficient_evidence: toy or reference values labelled as actual output
cargo test with zero or filtered required tests
gate_i_rule: Gate P may permit a separately authorized exact-revision consumer INTEGRATION TEST; it never supplies Gate I evidence itself.
partial_original_rule: T4L08/T4L09 material subcheck PASS must not be written as full original PASS.
sampling_rule: Finite stencil evidence is not proof on the full continuum or outside the selected domain.
local_result_location: task9-or-local-return evidence only; do not rewrite this Task7 authorship snapshot as observed execution.
